div.div: هَذَرٌ , a subst. from هَذَرَ فِى مَنْطِقِهِ, (S, Msb,) Much talk; babble: (JK:) or nonsense; or ??? rational, foolish, or delirious, talk: (S:) or confused and improper speech: (Msb:) or speech, or talk, that is much and bad: or erroneous: (A, K:) or that is not regarded as of any ??? or worth. (TA.) See also هَذْرٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
